identity.title: Enforce recipe and pipeline storage path boundaries

origin.kind: shared GPT Pro review confirmed by source inspection
origin.summary: The shared review reported that Pipeline, run, sample-set, and batch names can normalize outside their intended storage directory. Current Dev contains duplicated sanitizers, raw path segments, and no common post-combine containment gate.

state.current_summary: PL-0007 implemented and verified: RecipeWorkspaceService now owns strict Recipe/Pipeline storage-segment validation, canonicalization, and containment before mutation; lifecycle, sample-set, Run Report, Batch Summary, qualified snapshot, public runtime, build, readiness, reference, and public-sample checks passed. PL-0005 DLL license/provenance remains a separate Release blocker.

claims.text: Pipeline run, sample-set, and batch directory builders can retain dot segments and do not verify the final full path remains under the intended root.
Recipe and pipeline path validation is duplicated and does not consistently reject Windows reserved names, trailing dots or spaces, control characters, or raw child segments.

problem.impact: Untrusted or malformed names can escape an expected subdirectory, collide after Windows normalization, overwrite unrelated recipe artifacts, or leave active pointers and stored evidence inconsistent.

criteria.text: One domain-owned policy validates all new recipe, pipeline, run, sample-set, batch, config, and artifact path segments with explicit operator-facing failure messages.

Every storage path is canonicalized with Path.GetFullPath and proven to be the intended root or child before file-system mutation; dot segments, reserved devices, separators, control characters, trailing dots/spaces, and case collisions are covered.
Existing valid Korean/English/number/underscore names remain unchanged, and any legacy read compatibility or migration is explicit and does not weaken new-write validation.
Focused path and lifecycle checks prove no out-of-root file or directory is created and normal Recipe/Pipeline CRUD, samples, reports, snapshots, and clean runtime behavior still pass.

context.location: Recommended model: gpt-5.6-luna | Reasoning effort: high
Create a shared path policy only because multiple current storage owners duplicate the same security and data-integrity rule; do not introduce a general filesystem framework.

evidence.observation: GetVisionPipelineRunDirectory, sample-set, and batch builders call SanitizePathSegment and then Directory.CreateDirectory. SanitizePathSegment replaces invalid filename characters only, so '.' and '..' remain, and no final child-root containment check runs for these paths.

Recipe validation rejects only empty/dot/invalid-character names, several path builders use raw recipe or pipeline segments, and at least three independent SanitizePathSegment or NormalizePipelineName implementations remain in active storage and UI lifecycle paths.

The implementation centralizes strict storage-segment validation, Path.GetFullPath root/child containment, and contained relative-artifact resolution in RecipeWorkspaceService. Pipeline storage, lifecycle/exchange, sample-set, Run Report, Batch Summary, validation, dependency-copy, template-capture, and qualified working-copy callers route through the shared policy; invalid segments are checked before the corresponding filesystem mutation.

The current-source PL-0007 contract passed. It recorded contained pipeline/image/run/sample-set/batch/config/data/recipe paths, case-collision canonicalization, Recipe/Pipeline CRUD, sample-set save/load/context/delete, Run Report save/list, Batch Summary save/list, Recipe duplicate/rename/delete, rejected traversal/reserved-device/trailing-space/control-character inputs, and no rejected outside/reserved directory mutation.

Qualified Recipe snapshot smoke passed with payload and runtime verification, idempotent reuse, revision/lifecycle transitions, tamper rejection, runtime-mismatch separation, interrupted-creation exclusion, failed-creation rollback, and source-Recipe deletion followed by successful verification.
The current public Matching Recipe/Pipeline replay passed with Matching_Preview, a 572x420 result image, ResultCount=3, 19 metrics, and 3 runtime overlays.

The Debug solution build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; OpenVisionLab readiness passed; TestExternalReferences.ps1 passed its technical check with exit 0; and TestPublicSampleAssets.ps1 passed with CatalogRows=33, ManifestAssets=229, Pipelines=17. The external-reference BLOCKED license/provenance rows remain assigned to PL-0005 and are not treated as release approval.

events.summary: Cause: duplicated and incomplete Recipe/Pipeline storage path validation. Goal/result: one domain-owned policy now validates and contains new writes before mutation, while legacy read compatibility remains explicit; current focused, lifecycle, snapshot, runtime, build, readiness, reference, and public-sample evidence satisfies C1-C4.
